number-contract v4 payments signing bytes — golden vector
============================================================

Domain: b"number:v4:payments" (SIGNING_DOMAIN_PAYMENTS).
Encoding: domain || seq:u64 LE || settled_count:u8
|| each settled id (16 raw bytes) || tag:u8 (0 = no entry, 1 = entry),
then for tag 1: id(16 raw) || src(32) || dst(32) || amount:i64 LE
|| srcAddr_len:u32 LE || srcAddr || dstAddr_len:u32 LE || dstAddr
|| cursor:u8 || phase:u8 || status:u8 || fail:u8 || next(32)
|| legs_count:u8 || per leg: slot:u8 || seq:u64 LE || postValue:i64 LE || sig(64).
Settled ids are 32 lowercase hex chars (16 raw bytes), oldest first, at most 8,
no duplicates. The entry encoding after the tag is unchanged from the previous
vector.
Tags: phase forward=0/reverse=1/terminal=2;
status offered=0/acted=1/complete=2/reversing=3/reversed=4/aborted=5/blocked=6/superseded=7;
fail none=0/negative=1/no-destination=2/busy=3/refused=4/address-mismatch=5/blocked=6/superseded=7.
Digest is BLAKE3(signing bytes)[0..16], lowercase hex.
